properties.name: app.jwt.issuer
properties.description: JWT issuer identifier.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT signing secret key.

properties.name: app.jwt.access-token-minutes
properties.description: JWT access token expiration time in minutes.

properties.name: app.auth.first-user-admin-enabled
properties.description: Enable first user as admin during registration.

properties.name: app.oauth.google.client-ids
properties.description: Comma-separated list of Google OAuth 2.0 client IDs.

properties.name: app.oauth.google.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: Google's JWKS URI for token verification.

properties.name: app.oauth.telegram.bot-token
properties.description: Telegram bot token for authentication.

properties.name: app.oauth.telegram.auth-max-age-seconds
properties.description: Telegram authentication maximum age in seconds.

properties.name: app.oauth.telegram.email-domain
properties.description: Email domain suffix for Telegram users.

properties.name: app.oauth.telegram.client-id
properties.description: Telegram OIDC client ID.

properties.name: app.oauth.telegram.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: Telegram's JWKS URI for token verification.

properties.name: app.security.cors.enabled
properties.description: Enable CORS support.

properties.name: app.security.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.

properties.name: app.security.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed HTTP methods.

properties.name: app.security.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed request headers.

properties.name: app.security.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of exposed response headers.

properties.name: app.security.cors.max-age-seconds
properties.description: CORS preflight cache duration in seconds.

properties.name: app.security.https.required
properties.description: Require HTTPS for all requests.

properties.name: app.security.https.hsts-enabled
properties.description: Enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS).

properties.name: app.security.https.hsts-max-age-seconds
properties.description: HSTS max-age directive in seconds.

properties.name: app.security.logging.enabled
properties.description: Enable API request/response logging.

properties.name: app.security.logging.include-query-string
properties.description: Include query strings in API logs.

properties.name: app.security.logging.include-health-checks
properties.description: Include health check endpoints in API logs.

properties.name: app.security.upload.enabled
properties.description: Enable file upload validation.

properties.name: app.security.upload.max-file-size-bytes
properties.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes.

properties.name: app.security.upload.max-files
properties.description: Maximum number of files per upload.

properties.name: app.security.upload.allowed-content-types
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed MIME types.

properties.name: app.security.upload.allowed-extensions
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions.

properties.name: app.security.upload.verify-signatures
properties.description: Verify file signatures/magic bytes.

properties.name: app.security.client-address.forwarded-headers-enabled
properties.description: Extract client address from X-Forwarded-For headers.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.backend
properties.description: Rate limiting backend (redis, memory, etc).

properties.name: app.rate-limit.redis-key-prefix
properties.description: Redis key prefix for rate limit data.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.fail-closed
properties.description: Fail closed (block requests) on rate limit check failure.

properties.name: app.waf.enabled
properties.description: Enable Web Application Firewall (WAF).

properties.name: app.waf.audit-only
properties.description: WAF audit mode (log only, don't block).

properties.name: app.waf.protected-path-prefixes
properties.description: Comma-separated list of path prefixes to protect with WAF.

properties.name: app.waf.allowed-methods
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed HTTP methods.

properties.name: app.waf.max-uri-length
properties.description: Maximum allowed URI length in bytes.

properties.name: app.waf.max-query-length
properties.description: Maximum allowed query string length in bytes.

properties.name: app.waf.max-body-bytes
properties.description: Maximum allowed request body size in bytes.

properties.name: app.waf.max-header-value-length
properties.description: Maximum allowed header value length in bytes.

properties.name: app.waf.max-header-count
properties.description: Maximum allowed number of headers per request.

properties.name: app.waf.max-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum requests per minute per IP.
